close: In a crisis, the room steadies around your voice.
Underneath, you want to feel needed on days when nothing is going wrong.
Those around you end up working at your pace, even on their slow days.
Around you, decisions get made and the work starts.
Nobody thinks to ask how you are holding up.
Your colleagues get fewer chances to decide things for themselves.
Your nerve is what others lean on when the outcome is in doubt.
Some of what you lose is lost only for the thrill.
Your family and team feel every swing you take.
You are usually the only one in the room who will.
A good line has closed doors you wanted open.
The quieter ones get heard in your words more than their own.
Your best work happens live, and the crowd gets all of it.
What you want, under it all, is to be liked with the lights off.
Those closest to you get the act and miss the person behind it.
On a deadline, everyone looks to you for the first word.
The better idea often arrives after you have spoken.
Slower thinkers lose the last part of their point to your reply.
Your leaps often land where others arrive months later.
Ideas you saw first turn up later under other people's names.
Your listeners are left holding a conclusion they cannot retrace.
What you understand, you understand down to the roots.
Much of your time goes into ground others crossed years ago.
Those who know the subject never get to teach you.
What you bring back has been tested from every side.
Underneath, you want someone near while you work it out, no explaining needed.
Your partner and friends get days of silence with no word on why.
Your friends hear about the good openings from you.
What you already have gets less of you than it deserves.
The people you work with are left holding unfinished work.
Around you, nobody goes short for long.
Your own ventures get funded last, from whatever remains.
Your household's best stories come from the days you made.
Much of what your circle now enjoys exists because you went first.
What you are after is the feeling of the first day, again and again.
Their evenings go into seeing your ideas through.
With you in the race, everyone runs faster.
Your body pays for every race, including the ones you won.
Nothing with you is ever just a game.
What you are hungry for is a contest worth your whole heart.
Some of your hardest wins were for things you never cared about.
The win they pictured alone ends up with you in it.
Your friends never have to wonder whose side you are on.
Your savings rise and fall with the plans of the people you love.
Your money makes their plan bigger and riskier than they chose.
People leave a talk with you feeling lighter than they came.
Most of those close to you know little of what you carry.
Friends who came for your advice leave with only your sympathy.
Under your roof, everyone breathes out.
Your hobbies, friendships and plans all wait their turn behind everyone else's.
They miss the pride of getting through it without you.
People grow into their better selves on the credit you extend.
Some of your warmth goes to those who never return it.
They walk away with your warmth and without your verdict.
People build their plans on your yes.
Better offers come and go while you honour an old one.
Your friends have their offhand words held to the letter.
Your work is the standard others get checked against.
Chances that needed a quick call pass you by.
The people you work with turn in sounder work for your standards.
What you want is a place no one could question.
Money owed to you stays on the table for years.
Colleagues climb the slow way, with no help from you.
Your friendships are decades old, and they still hold.
Your savings are tied up in things you stopped loving long ago.
Home life with you has everything except the unexpected.
The lean months find your household ready.
What you want is proof that you are safe enough to enjoy something.
Your family's treats come after the budget.
Those who count on you have never once been left waiting.
Your health quietly pays for that perfect attendance.
They get your company without fail and seldom the thing they wanted.
Projects exist because you began them while others were still talking.
Everything you begin is paid for in hours nobody sees.
The people around you get a say only after the shape is set.
Your friends never feel managed or looked down on by you.
On your hard days, nobody is close enough to catch you.
Those who love you rarely get to be needed by you.
Setbacks that flatten others barely slow you.
What you want is care that does not cost you your pride.
Your friends arrive with help to find you already on your feet.
The people near you feel looked after before they know they need it.
Underneath, you want someone to offer before you have to ask.
Those close to you seldom get the pleasure of returning the favour.
A dinner with you turns into an occasion.
Hours on your own feel empty, and the good in them passes you by.
Their own ideas of a good time get lost inside yours.
Your work has a lightness people feel at once.
Your income is smaller than your talent.
Anyone watching you sees how good the result can be.
